text:
sam: quick q — if a client omits the `model` param, what's the *official* behavior now? default to pinned model, fall back to 'stable' alias, or error?

nina: default is still the pinned model for that org + route, but we just changed the global default alias behavior last week. canary rollout is 10% traffic on dedicated.

jordan: are client SDKs expected to send an explicit header to avoid surprises? e.g. `X-Redwood-Model: redwood-1.4` or `X-Model-Version: pinned`?

nina: yes, recommend SDKs set `X-Redwood-Model` when calling critical endpoints. server will honor header if model available, otherwise it returns 409 with a friendly JSON explaining available variants.

ryan: FYI CI showed a mismatch in the JS SDK — it currently strips unknown headers. failing test: `should_preserve_model_header` in integration suite.

devops-bot: deploying canary redwood-runtime v2.3.1 to us-west-canary (10% traffic) — deploy id: dpl_2026_03_15_9087

qa: can we get a short checklist for a safe default-change rollout? want to add to regression test matrix.

nina: draft checklist (short):
- update SDKs to include explicit model header + tests
- add unit test for missing `model` param => returns pinned model
- add contract test for 409 payload when header references unavailable variant
- run canary for 48h, then 24h extended if errors > 0.1% per route
- publish deprecation note for clients relying on implicit aliasing

sam: pinging @jordan and @ryan for SDK patch + CI fix. timeline? can we get a patch in this week?

jordan: I can patch SDK this afternoon and add test. need help from ryan to reproduce CI env locally.

ryan: I can repro — the strip happens in the fetch wrapper. quick fix: preserve custom headers starting with `X-Redwood-` and add a test. will open PR and link here.

jordan: thanks — will watch. once PR lands we should run the compatibility harness against a matrix of pinned vs alias configs.

qa: for docs: please add example curl + Python snippet showing explicit header and fallback handling. example:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Model: redwood-1.4" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```

nina: also note deprecation timeline: 60 days notice before changing global alias behavior for customers with active usage. ops will trigger email 14 days before final cut.

sam: ok — sounds like plan. thanks all. I'll add the checklist to the rollout RFC and tag folks for reviews. :thumbsup:

devops-bot: canary metrics: latency + error rate will be posted to #eng-runtime in ~10m — subscribe with `!subscribe dpl_2026_03_15_9087` if you want alerts.

ryan: PR opened: https://git.redwood.internal/sdk-js/pull/487 — fixes header stripping + adds unit tests. @jordan please review.

jordan: reviewing now. if green, I'll cut SDK patch and publish a minor release.

qa: once SDK release is out, QA will run the compatibility harness against latest canary and prod pinned models. will report results in this thread.

sam: perfect. leaving this thread open for any regressions.
